summary_en: The Blessed Virgin Mary under the title Santa Maria delle Grazie is confirmed as heavenly patroness of the city of Verbicaro, diocese of San Marco Argentano-Scalea (Italy); a single town.
excerpt: Beata Maria Virgo sub titulo Santae Mariae Gratiarum: Patrona caelestis civitatis v.d. Verbicaro; Sancti Marci Argentanensis-Scaleensis, Italia (21 maii 2010, Prot. 291/10/L).

summary_en: St James, apostle, is confirmed as heavenly patron of the town of Brzesko, diocese of Tarnów (Poland); a single town.
excerpt: Sanctus Iacobus, Apostolus: Patronus caelestis oppidi v.d. Brzesko; Tarnoviensis, Polonia (22 maii 2010, Prot. 297/10/L).

summary_en: St James, apostle, is confirmed as heavenly patron of the diocese of Fajardo-Humacao (Puerto Rico).
excerpt: Sanctus Iacobus, Apostolus: Patronus caelestis dioecesis Faiardensis-Humacaënsis, Portus Ricus (25 maii 2010, Prot. 361/10/L).

celebration.name_latin: Beata Maria Virgo de Monte Carmelo

summary_en: The Blessed Virgin Mary of Mount Carmel is confirmed as secondary heavenly patroness of the diocese of Fajardo-Humacao (Puerto Rico); a second act under the same protocol as the confirmation of St James, dated one day later.
excerpt: Beata Maria Virgo de Monte Carmelo: Patrona caelestis secundaria dioecesis Faiardensis-Humacaënsis, Portus Ricus (26 maii 2010, Prot. 361/10/L).

summary_en: St Urban, pope, is confirmed as heavenly patron of the city of Zielona Góra, diocese of Zielona Góra-Gorzów (Poland); a single city.
excerpt: Sanctus Urbanus, papa: Patronus caelestis urbis Viridimontanae; Viridimontanensis-Gorzoviensis, Polonia (22 iun. 2010, Prot. 101/10/L).

summary_en: Our Lady of Sorrows is confirmed as heavenly patroness of the parish of the Most Precious Blood in Luna di Ortonovo, diocese of La Spezia-Sarzana-Brugnato (Italy); a single parish.
excerpt: Beata Maria Virgo Perdolens: Patrona caelestis paroeciae Deo in honorem Pretiosissimi Sanguinis Domini Nostri Iesu Christi in vico v.d. Luna de Ortonovo dicatae; Spediensis-Sarzanensis-Brugnatensis, Italia (28 iun. 2010, Prot. 224/10/L).

celebration.name_latin: Beatus Transitus Sancti Benedicti, abbatis et patroni Europae

summary_en: The territorial abbey of the Most Holy Trinity of Cava (Italy) is permitted to celebrate a solemn Mass of the Blessed Passing (Transitus) of St Benedict, abbot and patron of Europe; no date or grade is printed.
excerpt: Sanctissimae Trinitatis Caviensis, Italia: Conceditur ut Sancta Missa sollemnis in Beato Transitu Sancti Benedicti, abbatis et patroni Europae celebrari possit (22 ian. 2010; Prot. 10/10/L).

summary_en: The liturgical celebration of Blessed John Henry Newman, priest, is granted to the Confederation of the Oratory of St Philip Neri; no date or grade is printed (the same protocol covers the approval of the Latin and English texts of the collect and Office reading, not recorded).
excerpt: Confoederationis Oratorii S. Philippi Neri: Conceditur ut liturgicae celebrationes in honorem Beati Ioannis Henrici Newman, presbyteri, peragi valeant (15 iun. 2010, Prot. 820/09/L).
